description: This file contains Sass mixins for styling and animation purposes, including sidebar arrow blinking, responsive icon sizing, and SVG background handling.

methods.name: blink-function
methods.description: Defines keyframes for animating a blinking sidebar right arrow, altering opacity and color.

methods.name: icon-responsive
methods.description: Creates a mixin to resize icons responsively based on viewport size.

methods.name: svg-background
methods.description: Allows a SVG image to be used as a background and colorized using mask images.
